## Calculate bias

estimated minus true divided by true

```{r}

dp <- function(x) deparse(x, width.cutoff=150)
#probSurv = 0.93
probSurv = 0.95
#df2$bias    = df2$probSurv_est - probSurv   # need the directional component
df2$bias     = df2$psurv_est_mean - df2$psurv_real
#df2$bias     = df2$psurv_est_mean - probSurv 
#df2$pctbias = abs(df2$bias/probSurv)
df2$fractbias = abs(df2$bias/df2$psurv_real)
#df2$fractbias = abs(df2$bias/probSurv)
df2$pctbias   = df2$fractbias * 100
# df2$biasM    =df2$mark_s_mean - probSurv
# df2$pctbiasM = abs(df2$biasM/probSurv)
```

## Create boxplots

Hold all other variables constant and check the effect of one var at a time

Make sure the constant values match what's in the data, or you get blank plots

First, set the values for holding constant:

```{r}
# I don't think this does anything:
# grouped = data %>% group_by(num_nests, psurv_real, obs_int, storm_dur, storm_freq)

# These are values you can use to hold everything else constant while you change
# one variable (nice intermediate values)

nest   = 500
# nest = 200
surv   = 0.93
# surv_real = 0.95
# dur  = 2
# freq = 2
dur    = 3
freq   = 3
obsint = 3
hatch  = 20

nestdata <- nestdata %>% mutate(across(c(storm_dur, storm_freq, hatch_time, obs_int), as.factor))
```

Then create the boxplots:

### Generic boxplot function

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
var_filt <- function(vari){
  
  # plVars <- c("hatch_time", "obs_int", "storm_freq", "storm_dur", "num_nests")
  # plVars <- c(hatch, obsint, freq, dur, nest)
  plVars <- c(hatch, obsint, freq, dur)
  # names(plVars) <- c("hatch_time", "obs_int", "storm_freq", "storm_dur", "num_nests")
  names(plVars) <- c("hatch_time", "obs_int", "storm_freq", "storm_dur")
  # or maybe these should be the names and they should have the constant vals above?
  
  # plVars <- plVars |> select(!)
  # maybe select() isn't right for a vector anyway
  # plVars <- plVars[plVars!=vari]
  plVars <- plVars[names(plVars)!=vari]
  return(plVars)
  
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
univar_mod_lm <- function(resp, modData, vars){ 
  
  # browser()
  # vars <- c("species", "nest_age", "cam_fate", "fdate", "obs_int")
  # vars <- c("species", "nest_age", "c.fate", "fdate", "obs_int")
  # vars <- c("species", "nest_age", "cfate", "fdate", "obs_int")
  umod_ <- list()
  for(v in seq_along(vars)){
    f <- paste0(resp," ~ ", vars[v])
    cat(f,"\t")                             # print the models as they are called
    # umod_[[v]] <- glm(f, data=modData, family=binomial)
    umod_[[v]] <- lm(f, data=modData)
  }
  
  modsum <- list()
  
  for(i in length(vars)){
    modsum[[i]] <- summary(umod_[[i]])
  }
  # return(modsum_)

  return(modsum)
}
```

### Analysis of Deviance to compare two models

```{r}

mod_diff <- function(mFull, mAlt, modtype){ # argument order matters - names should help
  
  difVList <- which(!(names(coef(mFull))) %in% names(coef(mAlt)))
  
  comp <- anova(mFull, mAlt, test="LRT")
  cat("\nCompare to full or main effects model:\n\n")
  print(comp)
  
  cat("\n\nPercent difference in model coefficients (vs full or main effects model):\n\n")
  cat(names(coef(mFull))[-difVList], "\n")
  cat((abs(coef(mAlt)-coef(mFull)[-difVList]) / coef(mFull)[-difVList])) #
  cat("\n---------------------------------------------------------------")
}
```

### AIC values

```{r eval=FALSE}

# dp <- function(x) deparse(x, width.cutoff=150)

aic_mod <- function(mods){
  
  mods <- mods
  
  modEQ <- paste(sapply(mods,  
                        # function(x) str_extract(dp(x$call), "(?<=~\\s).+(?=,\\sf)")
                        function(x) str_extract(dp(x$call), "(?<=~\\s).+(?=\")")
                        ), sep = " ")
  
  m <- str_match(modEQ, "(\\w+)\\s\\*\\s(\\w+)" )
  # n <- gsub(" ", "\\\\s", str_match(modEQ, "(\\w+)\\s\\*\\s(\\w+)") )
  # n
  
  p <- paste(m[,1], sep="|", collapse="|") # this grabs the correct strings
  p <- gsub(" ", "\\\\s", p)
  p <- gsub("\\*", "\\\\*", p)
  
  r <- function(eq) {
    # eq = "species * obs_int"
    r = which(m[,1] %in% eq)
    paste0(m[r,2]," + ",m[r,3]," + ",m[r,2],":",m[r,3])
  }
  
  modEQ <- str_replace(modEQ, p, r)
  
  nestAIC <- aictab(cand.set = mods, modnames = modEQ, sort = T)

  AICtab <- gt(nestAIC) |> 
    cols_hide(c(LL, ModelLik, Cum.Wt)) |>
    tab_header(title="AIC scores") |>
    # tab_style(
      # style = cell_text
      # style = cell_text(size="small"),
      #         locations= cells_body())
    # )
    tab_options(
      # table.font.weight = "bold",
      # was going to try setting whole table to bold and then body cells to normal
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
    )
  return(AICtab)
  
}
```

```{r}
dp <- function(x) deparse(x, width.cutoff=150)

 # df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, digits=3)) 
modnames <- function(mods){
  modEQ <- paste(sapply(
    mods,  
    function(x) str_extract(dp(x$call), "(?<=~\\s)(.*)(?=\")")
    ), sep = " ")
  
  m <- str_match(modEQ, "(\\w+)\\s\\*\\s(\\w+)" )
  # n <- gsub(" ", "\\\\s", str_match(modEQ, "(\\w+)\\s\\*\\s(\\w+)") )
  # n
  
  p <- paste(m[,1], sep="|", collapse="|") # this grabs the correct strings
  p <- gsub(" ", "\\\\s", p)
  p <- gsub("\\*", "\\\\*", p)
  
  r <- function(eq) {
    # eq = "species * obs_int"
    r = which(m[,1] %in% eq)
    paste0(m[r,2]," + ",m[r,3]," + ",m[r,2],":",m[r,3])
  }
  
  modEQ <- str_replace(modEQ, p, r)
  modEQ <- str_replace_all(modEQ, c(
    "species" = "SPECIES",
    "obs_int" = "FINAL_INTERVAL",
    "cam_fate" = "TRUE_FATE",
    "nest_age" = "NEST_AGE",
    "fdate" = "END_DATE",
    "storm_dur" = "DURATION",
    "storm_freq" = "FREQUENCY"
    ))
  modEQ[2] <- "NULL"
  
  return(modEQ)
}
```

Save tables to file and enable inclusion in the knitted output

```{r include=FALSE}
# Input DPI for gt table AIC table output:
dpi      <- (1800/6)                          # img width (px) / desired img width (in)

nm       <- function(x) substitute(x)

save_tab <- function(tab){
  
  now = format(Sys.time(), "%m%d_%H%M%S") # seconds bc tables all generated in < 1 min
  nm       <- function(x) substitute(x)

  file_name <- paste0(nm(tab), now, ".rtf") 
  gtsave(tab, file_name, path="analysis/")
  # gtsave(tab, file_name, path="analysis/")
  
  file_name1 <- paste0(nm(tab), now, ".png")
  gtsave(tab, file_name1, path="analysis/")
  
  # file_name2 <- paste0(nm(tab), now, "_rounded.png")
  # tab2 <- tab |> fmt_number(decimals=2)
  # gtsave(tab2, file_name2, path-"analysis/") 
  return(file_name1)
}
```
